approach: Wire Phase F answers into a new helpDocs field on the working-copy store (sibling to attribution, not KeyboardIR), populated via a dedicated onCommit hook on Phase F's step options. A new pure render module in the engine turns those answers plus existing design-derived metadata into README.md/readme.htm/welcome.htm/help/<id>.php, hooked into projectWorkingCopyForOutput so all three delivery modes regenerate on every produce.

decisions.decision: Populate helpDocs via a dedicated onCommit store action, not the generic writes/mutate pipe
decisions.why: the generic pipe is unimplemented for every live question module today (T014); attribution already proves the dedicated-action pattern end to end
decisions.rejected: implementing the project-wide writes/mutate mechanism as a side effect of this feature

decisions.decision: Hook doc rendering into projectWorkingCopyForOutput, not buildOutputBundle/ensurePackageFiles
decisions.why: only projectWorkingCopyForOutput is shared by all three delivery modes (.kmp, .zip, GitHub PR); ensurePackageFiles is download-only and write-if-absent, which cannot satisfy FR-010 regenerate-every-time
decisions.rejected: calling the new render step separately from all three call sites

decisions.decision: Fetch the base keyboard own welcome.htm/help.php as side-channel fields (baseWelcomeHtmText/baseHelpPhpText), mirroring baseLicenseText
decisions.why: fetchKeyboardSourceToVfs never fetches these today, so FR-013 merge has nothing to merge with until they are fetched; baseLicenseText is an exact existing precedent for fetch-without-writing-to-VFS
decisions.rejected: writing the base docs straight into the authoring VFS at fetch time and merging in place

decisions.decision: Project link (FR-012) maps to the kps <WebSite> element, home-page line only
decisions.why: sampled the ../keyboards corpus directly - single <WebSite URL=...> element is the only convention in use (250+ keyboards), no precedent for a second entry
decisions.rejected: emitting a second <WebSite> for the help-page line

decisions.decision: docs/keyboard-documentation-plan.md ships on this branch as a Setup task
decisions.why: spec.md Governing Context cites it as already-authoritative but it exists only on the unmerged km/keyboard-documentation-plan branch
decisions.rejected: leaving the citation dangling and re-deriving its content informally

decisions.decision: km-lead post-implement review cycle: km-verification+km-qc+km-frontend+km-synthesis run in parallel; 2 P1s fixed directly (stale comments in packageDocs.ts/buildOutputBundle.ts) plus 2 missing test cases added (setHtmlLang replace-path, mergeWithBase no-anchor fallback); remaining P2s deferred as noted concerns
decisions.why: no P0 blockers found; P1s were cheap mechanical fixes, so fixed inline rather than a second dispatch cycle
